title: [Bug 645022] UI improvements for report themes and header/footers (composite layout)
summary: Report layout administration pages now decode composite layout references, add description fields, and provide actions to replace layout files, edit descriptions, and view usage information. Changes are display-only with no schema or data impact.
key_points: Tenant Report Layout Configuration page decodes composite layout names from raw platform format to plain names
Report Theme and Header/Footer page gains Description column, Replace, Edit description, and Show info line-level actions
New Report Theme Header/Footer page includes a Description field when creating parts
Report Layouts page restricts composite layout actions to Word layouts only
All changes use existing underlying methods with no breaking modifications
quote: UI improvements for the composite-layout (Document Report Experience) theme and header/footer administration, plus fixes for the automated review feedback.
